item.title: Xiaomi Mi Buds 3 – AED 180 (60% Off) | tbreak
item.description: Xiaomi's ANC earbuds drop to just AED 180 at Jumbo — that's 60% off the AED 449 retail price. Solid choice for budget-conscious buyers wanting noise cancellation and 30-hour battery life without premium costs.

item.title: Dota 2 Games Future 2026: $1M prize, July dates | tbreak
item.description: Kazakhstan's Astana will host the world's top Dota 2 teams competing for US$1 million at Games of the Future 2026. The July tournament moves from Abu Dhabi to a 5,000-seat arena, expecting over 100,000 fans across eight gaming disciplines.

item.title: RavPower Travel Power Bank – AED 223 (30% Off) | tbreak
item.description: RavPower's versatile 5-in-1 travel power bank drops to AED 223 at Jumbo, saving you AED 96. The 10,000mAh unit combines multiple charging functions in one compact device, perfect for travellers who want to ditch carrying separate accessories.

item.title: Gaming PC Overheating in UAE: Best Cooling Fixes
item.description: UAE summers don't forgive weak cooling. Here's every fix that actually works — from AED 33 thermal paste to full AIO liquid coolers.

item.title: Amazon Transformer phone: new Alexa AI smartphone | tbreak
item.description: Amazon's 'Transformer' phone would prioritise Alexa AI over traditional apps, potentially serving as a secondary device alongside your main smartphone. The project marks Amazon's cautious return to mobile after the Fire Phone's 2014 disaster.

item.title: Robby Collins Dubai 2026: tickets from Dhs 140 | tbreak
item.description: South African comedy superstar brings his Netflix-proven material to six UAE shows this April, joined by Italian sensation Valentina Danubio and two debut acts. Early bird tickets Dhs 140 until 2 April for the over-21s only comedy experience.

item.title: ASUS ROG Strix XG27ACS – AED 999 (29% Off) | tbreak
item.description: This 27" Fast IPS gaming monitor drops to AED 999 at Jumbo, saving you AED 400. The ROG Strix XG27ACS delivers 180Hz refresh rates and 1ms response times with USB-C connectivity — solid specs for competitive gaming without OLED pricing.

item.title: Square Enix adds AI chatbot to Dragon Quest X | tbreak
item.description: Square Enix teams up with Google to launch Chatty Slimey, an AI companion powered by Gemini that helps new players navigate the Japan-exclusive MMO. The chatbot responds to in-game events and provides contextual guidance through voice interactions.

item.title: Epic Games cuts 1,000 jobs as Fortnite slumps | tbreak
item.description: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney blames Fortnite's declining player engagement for forcing the company to cut 23% of its workforce. Despite remaining the top console game, monthly playtime dropped 25% year-over-year as Epic spends more than it earns.

item.title: The Boys Season 5 UAE: streams 8 April on Prime | tbreak
item.description: Creator Eric Kripke confirms The Boys finale won't have massive battle scenes due to budget constraints. Instead, Season 5 focuses on intimate character confrontations as Homelander rules America and nobody is safe from episode one.
